scripts.dev: concurrently -n app,api -c cyan,green "npm run dev:h5 -w frontend" "npm run dev -w backend"
scripts.build: npm run build:h5 -w frontend && npm run build -w backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w frontend && npm run typecheck -w backend
scripts.test: npm run build -w backend && node --test backend/tests/*.test.mjs
